decision: Keep shipping midpoint unchanged. Stronger diagnostics improve nearly all long isolated notes with one reconstructed envelope, but worsen the complete held-out sequence and the nominal1s sensitivity. No topology or resonance-curve identification follows.

protocol.recipe_policy: Q0 onset-corrected recipe learned solely from note36; no Q50 recipe or envelope refit
protocol.nominal_resonance: Author's 50% knob label; raw64 is a hypothesis, raw63 is an adjacent-code sensitivity
protocol.timing_policy: Training-note first sample-difference threshold0.001 of local peak; thresholds0.003 and0.01 recorded as sensitivity only. Lag from checkpoint raw64 is shared by every Q50 model at the same slope.
protocol.gain_policy: One RMS scalar per whole render, fitted only from training note at fixed shared lag; also report candidate using exact baseline gain
protocol.qualification: No recording-specific SysEx; original MP3/capture chain unknown; heldout here means excluded from nuisance fitting, not never inspected by DSP development. No validated perceptual pass margins.
